gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 were GBP 267.622m. During 2018 the syndicate recorded a calendar year technical surplus of GBP 3.8m relating to reassessment of net claims for previous accident years (a release of reserves). The release is modest relative to opening gross reserves (approximately 1.4%) and reflects favourable development on prior accident years. The syndicate experienced significant catastrophe activity in 2018 (Hurricanes Florence and Michael; Camp and Woolsey wildfires) though these were, in aggregate, smaller than the 2017 catastrophe losses (including Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria). No aggregate gross prior-year strengthening/weakening figure (gross basis) for prior years is explicitly provided beyond the stated net surplus on prior years.
raw_causal_phrases: Within the calendar year technical result, a surplus of GBP 3.8m (2017: deficit of GBP 2.0m) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.
The net claims ratio reflects another year of heightened catastrophe experience, with the largest events being Hurricanes Florence and Michael as well as Camp and Woolsey Wildfires.
While still generating significant losses, they were in total less than the 2017 catastrophe losses which included Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, resulting in an improved year on year loss ratio.
